youtube.title: How One Rubbish Fire Wrecked a Town #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Smoke rises out of a road in Pennsylvania. Not from a chimney, from the ground itself. Why? In May 1962, the town of Centralia burned its rubbish dump before Memorial Day, the usual way. But the dump sat in an old pit beside an opening into abandoned coal mines, and the fire found the coal. Coal doesn't just burn, it smoulders for years. One rubbish fire, in the wrong place, ended a town. Full episode on the channel.
